description: This file defines a C# class 'CachedCatalogItemServiceDecorator' that implements the 'ICatalogItemService' interface. It acts as a decorator that adds local storage caching capabilities to the catalog item service by wrapping an existing service and utilizing local storage for caching data with a simple time-based invalidation.

classes.name: CachedCatalogItemServiceDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class implementing ICatalogItemService that adds caching via local storage to an underlying catalog item service.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Retrieves a paged list of catalog items, utilizing caching to reduce service calls.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Retrieves the full list of catalog items, utilizing caching.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Gets a specific catalog item by id, using cached list if available.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new catalog item and refreshes the cache.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Edits an existing catalog item and refreshes the cache.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a catalog item by ID and refreshes the cache.

methods.name: RefreshLocalStorageList
methods.description: Clears and updates the cached list of catalog items in local storage.
